Chirality established by the orientation-aware test -- is_isometric_to(mirror) is NOT a chirality test, it returns True through orientation-REVERSING isometries; m208's isometries to its mirror all have cusp-map det -1, m004's carry both signs. Standard and high precision cross-checked (a str() display artifact on snappy's HP Number, not a disagreement). CONSEQUENCE: the object's blindness to the level -- 'no dimensionful quantity, by theorem' -- STANDS for m004 (CS=0 is exact, being 2-torsion) but its REASON is corrected from a symmetry theorem to a CONTINGENT datum: which element of the symmetry-given Z/2 this object sits at. Six reader-facing surfaces asserted the falsified equivalence, two of them THEOREM-graded rows in docs/THE_CLAIM.md -- E53 (surface non-propagation) from B1224, banked the same day. CELL 2 -- the owner's category correction, made computational: '19 parameters' / '26' is a flat list of things of different KIND. Typed by this programme's own law (B1168: object-canonical <=> beta-even AND dimensionless) the 28 split 6/3/16/3 into four boxes with four different suppliers: A beta-even pure (6: CKM+PMNS angles) -- NOBODY, B1225 proves the object cannot select; B scale-anchored (3: the gauge couplings, dimensionless but running) -- READER; C dimensionful (16: all masses, v, m_H, G, Lambda) -- READER; D beta-odd (3: theta_QCD, delta_CKM, delta_PMNS) -- the ONLY box where the object has an output. MB12 bite: 4/4 boxes occupied, non-vacuous; the flat count occupies 1/4. CELL 3 -- the object's box-D output is CS, forced 2-torsion, i.e. ONE BIT. Every probe the programme ever fired into box D demanded a CONTINUOUS VALUE: B1027 (delta_13 = 120/240 deg, MISS 11.4/38.0 sigma), B1137 (algebraic combinations over 18 sealed targets, DISJOINT), B813 (CS = theta_QCD, REFUTED ON TYPE). 3/3 demanded a value; 0/3 asked the bit. The type-matched question -- does the object's Z/2 fix the CP-CONSERVATION BIT rather than a phase magnitude -- has never been asked, and B303 ('the CP sign is literally the sign of Chern-Simons', PROVED) already sits at bit level, never connected to those negatives. NOT CLAIMED: no CP phase is derived, no measured value is asserted, Gate 5 intact; B813's refutation of the VALUE dictionary stands untouched.
